entities.summary: Peter Ryom is a Danish musicologist. He is internationally known as the author of the Ryom-Verzeichnis, the now-standard catalogue of the works of Antonio Vivaldi. The number of a composition in the Ryom Verzeichnis is always prefaced by the abbreviation RV.
